name: Color Dash
description: Tap to jump through spinning rings, only through your own color.

description_i18n.en: Tap to jump through spinning rings—but only through your matching color!

prompt: A one-tap game like Color Switch: tap to make a ball jump upward through rotating colored rings, it can only pass through the segment of its own color, color changers between obstacles, endless levels getting faster.
